name: Anusha Thotakura
office: Chicago Board of Education Member, Subdistrict 6A

items.text: Anusha Thotakura is the appointed Chicago Board of Education member for District 6A and executive director of Citizen Action/Illinois, a progressive policy coalition. She previously taught bilingual middle school math.

sentences.text: Anusha Thotakura is the appointed Chicago Board of Education member for District 6A and executive director of Citizen Action/Illinois, a progressive policy coalition.
She previously taught bilingual middle school math.

items.text: On the board, she drafted a resolution to study offering full-day preschool for 3-year-olds and providing special education services in private child care settings. She says she sponsored the Healthy Green Schools resolution for clean energy and building improvements. Her priorities include raising reading and math scores and increasing public data on academic progress. She voted for a Chicago Public Schools budget without high-cost borrowing, and later voted to amend a budget based on expected additional state money.
